demos.name: Agentic Logistics for Cold Chain Operators

card.description: Automated agentic operations and predictive IOT analytics ensure refrigerated transport (cold-chain) operators can solve the increasing pressure to reduce spoilage, improve real-time visibility, ensure compliance, respond faster, and build customer trust.

landingPage.description: Refrigerated transport (cold-chain) operators face increasing pressure to reduce spoilage, improve real-time visibility, ensure compliance, respond faster, and build customer trust. They need more than monitoring - they need predictive insight and clear actions. FleetOPTX recognized both a market gap and a strategic opportunity. With an already strong fleet management platform, they partnered with IBM to embed AI capabilities.

card.description: Rapidly build full-featured agentic applications matching pre-approved design comps then containerize and deploy to IBM Cloud using Spec-Driven Development.

landingPage.description:
IBM Bob supports interactive Vibe Coding but unlocks Spec-Driven Development unlocks his greatest potential.  Download the natural language specifications for this demo to learn how accurately IBM Bob can follow detailed instructions plus up-front website design images and datasets to build this website from scratch.

 The result is a full-featured website including agentic product search that helps future customers discover, evaluate, and order mission-critical equipment in natural-language.


The application was created using spec-driven development, with requirements, workflows, data models, user experiences, and acceptance criteria defined before implementation. These specifications give AI development tools a consistent blueprint, enabling engineers to build polished customer demos faster, reduce rework, and reliably extend the application as new technologies or scenarios are added.
